fallback.note: The old 1m reconstructions are preserved as *_reconstructed_1m.csv for the 232 symbols that have 1m bars; the main files are actual snapshots.

caveat: 09:55 is a pre-open reference using 2026-11-02 daily OHLCV, not a live capture. 13:55 and 14:05 are actual marketwatch snapshots from the live PostgreSQL source (237 symbols each; 14:05 was captured at 14:05:02 Cairo). The marketwatch open_price column is null; open is taken from the actual 2026-11-03 daily open. Bid/ask and quantities are available only for AALR from orderbook_snapshots; all other symbols have null bid/ask because no verified 2026-11-03 quote source exists. No quote or price was invented. No 2026-11-04 data is included.
